description: Defines data structures and parameters for refreshing composition outputs in Android's SurfaceFlinger. Includes classes for composition refresh arguments, border rendering info, and related types.

classes.name: BorderRenderInfo
classes.description: Contains information for rendering borders around layers, including width, color, and associated layer IDs.

classes.name: CompositionRefreshArgs
classes.description: Parameter object used for refreshing a set of outputs, containing output references, layer lists, buffer IDs, color settings, transformation flags, and other refresh-related options.
